verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same broken skyscraper: the six-session schedule is split up and out of order (13 Jan/09 Dec/20 Jan crammed at the top, 16 Dec stuck under the headline, 06 Jan below the CTA), so the dates are tiny and the order is lost. In both, the oversized CTA pill crowds the rows above and below it, and the logo and fine print end up in a cramped footer. B is slightly worse: its headline and image are wider and run nearer the canvas edges, its CTA nearly fills the full width, and stray micro-text by the logo adds clutter. A keeps marginally better side margins.
